html:
Binh Hung Island is not only known for its clear beaches and peaceful atmosphere but also for its rich and fresh seafood. Thanks to its location in Cam Ranh Bay, the island offers a wide variety of seafood that is caught daily and prepared in simple yet flavorful ways.

In this guide, Vietlook Travel introduces the most popular dishes you should try when visiting Binh Hung Island, along with useful tips to help you enjoy local cuisine in the best way.

Lobster – The Signature Dish of Binh Hung

Binh Hung is often called the “lobster island” because of its high-quality lobster farms. This is the most famous dish that almost every visitor wants to try.

Lobster here is usually prepared in several ways:

  • Grilled with garlic butter
  • Steamed to preserve natural sweetness
  • Cooked with porridge
  • Grilled with cheese

The meat is firm, naturally sweet, and very fresh since it is taken directly from local farms. This is a must-try experience when visiting the island.

Grilled Scallops with Scallion Oil

Grilled scallops are a popular street-style seafood dish. Fresh scallops are topped with scallion oil, peanuts, and sometimes a bit of fish sauce, then grilled over charcoal.

The result is a rich and aromatic flavor, combining sweetness from the scallop and the fragrance of scallion oil. It is simple but very satisfying.

Grilled Sea Urchin

Sea urchin is another specialty that reflects the richness of the local sea. It is usually grilled with scallion oil or eaten raw with lime.

The texture is creamy and slightly salty, offering a unique taste that many seafood lovers appreciate.

Steamed Squid

Squid in Binh Hung is known for its freshness and natural sweetness. Steaming is the most common cooking method to preserve its original flavor.

It is often served with salt, pepper, and lime sauce. The texture is tender and slightly chewy, making it a simple but memorable dish.

Seafood Hotpot

Seafood hotpot is a great option for groups or families. It includes a variety of ingredients such as fish, shrimp, squid, and vegetables.

The broth is usually slightly sour and spicy, creating a balanced and comforting flavor. It is best enjoyed while still hot, especially in the evening.

Grilled Fish

Fresh fish is widely available on the island and often grilled over charcoal. Popular types include grouper and snapper.

The fish is lightly seasoned to highlight its natural taste and served with fresh herbs and dipping sauce.

Local Snails and Shellfish

Binh Hung offers a wide variety of snails and shellfish such as clams, oysters, and other local varieties.

They are prepared in different styles:

  • Grilled with scallion oil
  • Stir-fried with garlic
  • Steamed with herbs

These dishes are commonly served in small portions, making them suitable for sharing.

Tips for Enjoying Food in Binh Hung

  • Choose places that display fresh seafood clearly
  • Ask for the cooking method that suits your taste
  • Visit early in the evening for the freshest options
  • Prepare cash as most local places do not accept cards
